facts.why: Wikipedia's plot dates the story to Friday, June 13, 1979, not summer 1980 (1980 is the release year). The prop line is changed to the story year.

vibe.verdict: A good mess hall with the diner, Crazy Ralph and strip Monopoly, though the food could joke harder about Mrs Voorhees being the camp cook.
